zh-CN.title: 把发言带进聊天
items: 每条广场发言现在都有可直接分享的独立链接
聊天会把站内发言展示为专属卡片，可直接预览图片、语音和视频
卡片同步展示点赞与评论，并可一键打开完整发言

en.title: Share posts in chat
items: Every Square post now has a shareable direct link
Sermo post links become rich chat cards with image, audio, and video previews
Cards show live likes and comments and open the full post in one tap
